method: Count only saved p.teaching-prose visible whitespace tokens with Unicode letters/digits after stripping tags/entities. Exclude headings, figures, tables, assessments, recall, references and navigation. Compare 7.B.08: 14,018 words, 147 paragraphs; 7.C.01: 14,610 words, 148 distinct paragraphs.

reviews.scientific: Internal review of all twelve roadmap areas, Fick-law assumptions, oxygen content versus pressure, ventilation geometry, fish gradients, amphibian pump, reptilian exceptions, bird airflow and crosscurrent mixing. Selected primary/review/textbook evidence checked. Independently recomputed numeric examples and checked every selected question answer after final option shuffle.
reviews.editorial: Separate pass on progressive ordering, accessible explanations, caveats, independent question wording, balanced nonperiodic answer positions, diagram labels and zoom, TOC anchors, heading levels, revision and syllabus boundaries. Corrected exchange graph and avian sequence schematic; added tables and misconceptions. No repeated prose paragraphs.
